# newreleases_hangouts_chat_webhooks (Data Source)

Lists Google Hangouts Chat webhooks configured in the account. Use their IDs in `newreleases_project.hangouts_chat_webhooks`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "newreleases_hangouts_chat_webhooks" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `webhooks` (Attributes List) Configured Google Hangouts Chat webhooks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhooks))
